::: {.assembly-project-shell}

<p class="assembly-lede"><strong>I wrote this final project in assembly for a microprocessor class focused on the Intel 8085 chip in 2020. I was learning assembly and getting introduced to coding, before AI coding assistants.</strong> I later built this browser-based 8085 simulator to revisit my original code and thought process from 2020. The comments have been rewritten for clarity, but the program logic is unchanged and fully functional. Try a temperature and watch the code, registers and flowchart work together to convert it to Fahrenheit.</p>
